name: Test Tube Droplet Preview
description: A short image-to-video preview of a clear droplet falling into a test tube containing unidentified white crystals.
subject: Laboratory demonstration
educational_goal: Show a controlled droplet entering a test tube while preserving the starting composition.

scene.scene: Macro laboratory view of a clear test tube held by a clamp, with white crystals at the bottom and a pipette above it.

prompt_bundle.image_prompt: A locked-off macro laboratory shot of a clear test tube held by a metal clamp. White crystals rest at the bottom. A pipette is positioned above the opening. Preserve the arrangement and framing of the reference image. Realistic glass reflections, soft neutral lighting, no labels or text.
prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: A pipette slowly releases one clear droplet. The droplet falls into the test tube containing white crystals. Keep the test tube, clamp, pipette, crystals, and camera framing in the same positions. Realistic glass reflections, steady camera, natural subtle motion.
prompt_bundle.direction: Downward from the pipette into the test tube
prompt_bundle.motion: The pipette releases one droplet which falls into the tube
prompt_bundle.constraints: Keep the test tube, clamp, pipette, crystals, and camera framing stable. Do not identify or change the substance in the tube.
prompt_bundle.stop_condition: The droplet has entered the test tube and the setup remains still
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: camera shake, zoom, cuts, extra pipettes, extra tubes, changing clamp, moving crystals, colored liquid, text, labels, distorted glass
